sources.title: Qwen3-VL Technical Report (Bai et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Three upgrades: interleaved-MRoPE (spatial-temporal modeling), DeepStack multi-level ViT features for tighter VL alignment, text-based time alignment evolving T-RoPE to explicit textual timestamps for precise temporal grounding; 256K native interleaved context (books, hours-long video, full recall, second-level indexing); dense 2B-32B + MoE 30B-A3B/235B-A22B; Instruct + Thinking editions.
claims.context: Qwen3-VL technical report body (interleaved-MRoPE, DeepStack, text-timestamp alignment sections) consumed from complete arXiv HTML; architecture claims are report-stated, author/developer self-reported numbers quarantined.

claims.text: Three pillars: stronger pure-text understanding (beats text-only backbones in cases); 256K long-context retention/retrieval/cross-referencing; leading MMMU/visual-math reasoning; sqrt-reweighting protects text while boosting multimodal.
claims.context: Report pillars section consumed; text-retention and reasoning claims are author/developer self-reported, not independent fact.

claims.text: Vision-to-LLM projection uses a two-layer MLP merger compressing 2x2 visual features into one visual token matched to the LLM hidden size; DeepStack adds dedicated merger modules projecting features from three ViT levels into visual tokens added via residual connections to the first three LLM layers with no extra context length. The vision encoder is SigLIP-2 (SO-400M default; Large-300M for 2B/4B) with dynamic native-resolution input, 2D-RoPE and size-interpolated absolute embeddings; grounding coordinates are normalized to [0,1000].
claims.context: arXiv:2511.21631v2 §2 Model Architecture (Vision Encoder + MLP-based Vision-Language Merger) + §2.2 DeepStack + Fig.1 + §3.2.4 grounding coordinates.

claims.text: Video time is encoded as explicit textual timestamp tokens prefixing each temporal patch (e.g. <3.0 seconds>); training uses both seconds and HMS (hours:minutes:seconds) formats so the model reads diverse timecodes. This replaces Qwen2.5-VL absolute-time positional alignment, avoiding large sparse temporal position IDs on long video and heavy uniform multi-fps sampling, at the cost of a modest context-length increase; it targets video grounding and dense captioning.
claims.context: arXiv:2511.21631v2 §2.3 Video Timestamp.

claims.text: Pre-training runs four stages: S0 trains only the merger on ~67B tokens at 8,192 length with encoder and LLM frozen; S1 full-parameter joint training on ~1T tokens at 8,192; S2 long-context training on ~1T tokens at 32,768 with more video/agent data; S3 ultra-long adaptation on 100B tokens at 262,144 focused on long video/document tasks. Text-only data is mixed throughout to preserve language ability; per-token square-root-normalized loss balances text and multimodal contributions.
claims.context: arXiv:2511.21631v2 §3.1 Training Recipe + Table 1 (S0-S3 budgets/lengths) + Intro square-root loss note.

claims.text: Static processing extracts video frames at a fixed rate (default 1 FPS, adjustable via API) and places them into context in a single pass; audio at 1Kbps single channel with timestamps added every second; fast action sequences may lose detail at 1 FPS.
claims.context: Docs processing-modes section + release post static baseline; static baseline for the agentic contrast.

claims.text: Agentic understanding replaces upfront full-timeline ingest with a reasoning-plus-tools loop that dynamically searches, scans, and inspects target video segments across visual frames, audio, and transcripts, fetching only the moments and signals needed per query.
claims.context: Release post How-it-works mechanism (fetched 2026-10-03).

claims.text: The model takes a goal-directed role deciding what to watch, at what speed, and through which modality (frames, audio, transcript), invoking an internal tool to load the relevant part of the video file per query.
claims.context: Release post body verbatim mechanism (fetched 2026-10-03).

claims.text: Agentic processing adaptively adjusts frame rates and resolution on the fly based on the prompt, and resamples interesting time windows at higher FPS to inspect rapid motion and subtle visual artifacts.
claims.context: Docs agentic-mode description + release post applications (adaptive specifics stay qualitative; no numeric FPS schedule claimed).

claims.text: Available for video uploads and YouTube videos via the Gemini API in AI Studio and Enterprise Agent Platform; enabled by setting processing to agentic; different processing modes may be set per video in the same request.
claims.context: Release post availability + docs per-video mode mixing + changelog API scope.

claims.text: The model dynamically navigates the timeline, requesting transcripts, frames, or audio tracks on demand to answer the prompt.
claims.context: Changelog entry verbatim + release post modality selection.

claims.text: Video context is preserved across turns: stateful mode via previous_interaction_id needs no additional handling; stateless mode must carry all returned steps including processing_call and processing_result in the next step_list, else video context is lost and follow-up quality degrades.
claims.context: Docs multi-turn section handling notes.

claims.text: Up to 88% fewer tokens than static processing for long-form content, because the model loads only needed transcript/frames/audio. Token scope only; not a memory, KV-cache, or latency claim.
claims.context: Changelog + docs token calculation; long-form condition explicit; fetched bodies confirm ceilings.

claims.text: Up to 66% lower analysis cost across standard video analysis benchmarks, at standard API token pricing with no additional feature fee. Cost scope only, separate from token scope.
claims.context: Release post Benchmarks; benchmark scope distinct from long-form token scope.

claims.text: Up to ~7% higher accuracy with agentic 3.7 Flash; agentic 3.7 Flash placed at the accuracy-to-cost pareto frontier among tested models for video understanding. Quality scope only, vendor-reported.
claims.context: Release post Benchmarks + frontier captions; tested-model scope.

claims.text: Navigation may slightly increase time to first token on short clips (under 5 minutes) due to internal reasoning and tool round-trips; static suits latency-sensitive short-clip or full-clip frame-precision queries.
claims.context: Docs Technical details + choose-mode guidance; <5 min condition.

claims.text: Navigation reasoning tokens count as thought tokens (total_thought_tokens); frames, audio, and transcript loaded on demand count as tool use tokens (total_tool_use_tokens); totals vary with content complexity and navigation strategy.
claims.context: Docs token-calculation section verbatim.
